title: Without Ticks
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 121
medium: Interactive page (index.html): one day (9 September 2009, the busiest of 5,479) shown through three preparations of US daily births 2000-2014 with enlarging lenses; the twelve still works fresh makers made from those preparations, grouped by preparation; and a clickable ledger of what each maker named. A figure (figure.svg); reproducibility and git-order verifier (verify.py).
embodies: Perceiving, with a material that cannot be decoded. Makers given a small compressed picture with no axes still decoded it, carried its own pixels into their pages and drew each pixel as wide as the days it held. The regular (the week, holidays, the season) passed every preparation. The dated singular (9.9.09, 6.6.06, the 13th) passed only the table: a picture can show the highest dot, not that its day was chosen.
project_step: Sixteenth experiment of the project. Operation: perceiving (with finding a form). Takes up experiment 15's open thread 3 (a lossy picture: do these makers still read it back to numbers, or begin to look?) and its conditions thread 4 (a room per maker, F-211: held) and thread 5 (a coder without captions, F-212: failed again, the mask did not reach canvas text, F-217). Keeps the fresh makers and blind coder of experiments 10-15 and experiment 15's table and picture arms as controls. Works with and against Iteration, not Imitation section 4 K3 (Simondon, MEOT 17: the margin of indeterminacy) and Cartography, not Tracing (map and tracing, ATP 12-13).
material: Births registered in the United States per day, 2000-2014, 5,479 values, Social Security Administration data via FiveThirtyEight (CC BY 4.0), fetched 2026-10-11; domain: demography (vital statistics)
seed: prepare.py seed 121 (arms); mask.py seed 1211 (coder order); makers and coder are model instances and not seeded
